question: Does an edge-wise cubic B-spline KAN parameterize the existing low-dimensional bounded interpolation-calibration law materially better than the current parameter-matched MLP?

motivation_boundary.problem_first_evidence: The frozen value_only model is driven mainly by B_linear and local scale at missing targets, and post-gate head ablation localizes measurable gains to bounded internal and edge offsets.
motivation_boundary.missing_evidence: There is no oracle or residual-complexity result showing that MLP expressivity is the current bottleneck.
motivation_boundary.research_role: A single low-cost popular-module collision, not a new open-ended architecture search and not independent paper confirmation.

hypothesis: If the useful correction is a locally smooth low-dimensional deformation law, learnable edge-wise cubic B-splines should be more parameter-efficient and inspectable than a fixed-activation MLP under the same information and output constraints.

arms.mlp_value: Exact current 5,475-parameter value_only incumbent, rerun in the same worker for operationally matched comparison.
arms.kan_value: Only replace the 16-to-three-logit MLP map with the single frozen 5,539-parameter cubic B-spline KAN.
arms.kan_static: The identical 5,539-parameter KAN with all 16 feature channels algebraically zeroed.

only_model_difference.replaced: LayerNorm(16) -> Linear(16,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,64) -> GELU -> three Linear(64,1) heads
only_model_difference.replacement: LayerNorm(16) -> edge-wise cubic B-spline KAN(16,32) -> edge-wise cubic B-spline KAN(32,3)

kan.output_layer_initialization: base and spline weights N(0,1e-4), bias zero, matching the incumbent near-Linear output prior

unchanged: canonical observation-only Linear and nearest-anchor edge rule
tanh, r_hat clipping, anchor and scale formulas
fit/source-dev/tune boundaries, masks, seeds, optimizer, and 320 updates

data.boundary: post-project development evidence; tune is not project-wide pristine and cannot become independent confirmation

training.precision: existing BF16-on-CUDA lane with numerically stable KAN basis implementation
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest pooled source-dev NMAE across the three masks, ties choose the earlier epoch

stop_rules.accuracy_fail: KILL_TINY_KAN_KEEP_VALUE_ONLY; do not run latency or zero-spline attribution.
stop_rules.spline_attribution_fail: Do not call the result a KAN/spline contribution even if full accuracy increased.
stop_rules.cost_fail: Do not replace the current accuracy-efficiency incumbent.
forbidden_followups: different grids, spline orders, widths, depths, learned grids, gates, routers, or auxiliary losses

paper_interpretation.strong_pass: A constrained spline calibrator remains only a candidate until a fresh confirmation is obtained.
paper_interpretation.single_dataset_or_small_gain: Retain as a negative/diagnostic result; do not alter the value_only paper identity.
paper_interpretation.failure: Freeze value_only and proceed with the existing CCF-C writing route.
